scheme.pmkisan.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
scheme.pmkisan.benefit: ₹6,000 every year, in three instalments of ₹2,000, straight into your bank account.
scheme.pmfby.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
scheme.pmfby.benefit: Insurance money if your crop is damaged. The farmer pays only a small share: at most 2% in Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for commercial or horticulture crops (like potato).
scheme.kcc.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
scheme.kcc.benefit: Farm loans up to ₹5 lakh at 7% interest (the limit was raised from ₹3 lakh). Only 4% if you repay on time. No security needed up to ₹2 lakh. Confirm with your bank.
scheme.shc.name: Soil Health Card
scheme.shc.benefit: A soil test for your field and a card that says which fertiliser to use and how much. A new test every 2 to 3 years.
reason.pmkisan.ownsLand.pass: Farm land is in your family's name.
reason.pmkisan.ownsLand.fail: This scheme needs farm land in your family's name.
reason.pmkisan.cutoff.pass: The land is from before 1 February 2019, or was inherited.
reason.pmkisan.cutoff.fail: Land got after 1 February 2019 has a different rule (except inherited land). Ask the agriculture office.
reason.pmkisan.incomeTax.pass: Nobody in your family paid income tax.
reason.pmkisan.incomeTax.fail: Someone in your family paid income tax. Such families are likely not covered.
reason.pmkisan.incomeTax.unsure: It is not known if someone in your family paid income tax. Ask the agriculture office.
reason.pmkisan.pension.pass: Nobody in your family gets a big pension or has a government job.
reason.pmkisan.pension.fail: Someone in your family gets a pension of ₹10,000 or more, or has a government job. Such families are likely not covered.
reason.pmkisan.pension.unsure: The pension or government job answer is not sure. Ask the agriculture office.
reason.pmkisan.professional.pass: Nobody in your family is a professional like a doctor or lawyer, or a leader in a high post.
reason.pmkisan.professional.fail: Someone in your family is a doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA, architect or a leader in a high post. Such families are likely not covered.
reason.pmkisan.professional.unsure: It is not sure if someone in your family is a professional or a leader in a high post. Ask the agriculture office.
reason.pmfby.cultivates.pass: You farm, on your own land or on sharecropped/rented land.
reason.pmfby.cultivates.fail: Crop insurance is for people who farm, on their own land or on sharecropped/rented land.
reason.pmfby.cropNotified.pass: Your crop is on your district's insurance list this season.
reason.pmfby.cropNotified.fail: Check that your crop is on your district's insurance list this season.
reason.kcc.cultivates.pass: You farm, on your own land or on sharecropped/rented land.
reason.kcc.cultivates.fail: The Kisan Credit Card is for people who farm, on their own land or on sharecropped/rented land.
reason.kcc.alreadyHave: You already have a KCC. Visit your bank to renew it or check the loan limit.
reason.shc.cultivates.pass: You farm, on your own land or on sharecropped/rented land.
reason.shc.cultivates.fail: The Soil Health Card is for people who farm.
reason.shc.recentTest: Your soil was tested recently. The next test is in about 2 years.
tip.pmkisan.ekyc: To get money straight into your account, link your bank account to Aadhaar and finish e-KYC (with OTP, fingerprint or face). This can also be done at a CSC.
tip.pmfby.askBank: You have a KCC or crop loan. Ask your bank if your crop insurance is already done.
doc.aadhaarCard: Aadhaar card (only to show at the office)
doc.bankPassbookLinked: Passbook of the bank account linked to Aadhaar
doc.landOrTenancy: Land papers, or a sharecropping/rent paper, or a sowing certificate (as the state asks)
doc.cropDetails: Details of the crops you grow
doc.soilSample: A soil sample (taken the way the agriculture office explains)
note.pmkisan.farmerId: Some states may ask for the government Farmer ID (AgriStack) for new registration.
note.pmkisan.nameMatch: Your name must be the same in Aadhaar and PM-KISAN records.
note.pmfby.lossReport72h: If your crop is damaged, report it within 72 hours (Crop Insurance App or helpline 14447).
note.pmfby.confirmNotified: Check that your crop is on the insurance list.
note.kcc.beforeSeason: Apply before the crop season starts.
deadline.pmfby.rabi: Last date for Rabi crop insurance
deadline.pmfby.kharif: Last date for Kharif crop insurance
note.pmkisan.oneFamily: Only one person in a family (husband, wife and children under 18) gets PM-KISAN. If two people get it, the money can be stopped until it is checked.
scheme.pmkmy.name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana (pension)
scheme.pmkmy.benefit: ₹3,000 pension every month after age 60. You pay a small amount each month until 60 (₹55 to ₹200, by your age), and the government adds the same amount.
reason.pmkmy.ownsLand.pass: Farm land is in your family's name.
reason.pmkmy.ownsLand.fail: This pension needs farm land in your name in the land records.
reason.pmkmy.smallFarmer.pass: You are a small farmer (up to 2 hectares, about 5 acres).
reason.pmkmy.smallFarmer.fail: This pension is only for small farmers with up to 2 hectares (about 5 acres).
reason.pmkmy.age.pass: You are 18 to 40 years old, the age to join.
reason.pmkmy.age.fail: You can join this pension only between 18 and 40 years of age.
reason.pmkmy.age.unsure: Your age is not known. You can join only between 18 and 40. Ask at the CSC.
note.pmkmy.contribution: If you get PM-KISAN, your monthly amount can be cut from that money, if you agree.
note.pmkmy.otherPension: Not for people already in NPS, ESIC or EPFO (PF).
note.pmkmy.csc: Join for free at a CSC (Common Service Centre).
scheme.namo.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (Maharashtra)
scheme.namo.benefit: ₹6,000 every year from the Maharashtra government, in three instalments of ₹2,000. This is on top of PM-KISAN.
note.namo.withPmkisan: Farmers who get PM-KISAN in Maharashtra get this too. Keep your PM-KISAN e-KYC and land records up to date.
scheme.rythuBharosa.name: Rythu Bharosa (Telangana)
scheme.rythuBharosa.benefit: ₹12,000 per acre every year from the Telangana government (₹6,000 per acre each season), straight into your bank account.
reason.rythuBharosa.cultivates.fail: Rythu Bharosa is for people who farm land.
reason.rythuBharosa.ownsLand.pass: Farm land is in your name (pattadar passbook).
reason.rythuBharosa.ownsLand.fail: Rythu Bharosa is paid on land in a pattadar passbook. Ask the agriculture office whether tenant farmers can get it.
note.rythuBharosa.landRecords: Money is paid for land shown as farm land in the Bhu Bharati land records.
scheme.rythuBima.name: Rythu Bima (Telangana farmer life insurance)
scheme.rythuBima.benefit: If the farmer dies for any reason, the family (nominee) gets ₹5 lakh. The Telangana government pays the premium.
reason.rythuBima.ownsLand.pass: Farm land is in your name (pattadar passbook).
reason.rythuBima.ownsLand.fail: Rythu Bima is for farmers who have a pattadar passbook.
reason.rythuBima.age.pass: You are 18 to 59 years old, the age it covers.
reason.rythuBima.age.fail: Rythu Bima covers only farmers aged 18 to 59.
reason.rythuBima.age.unsure: Your age is not known. It covers only ages 18 to 59. Ask the agriculture office.
note.rythuBima.ageAadhaar: Your age is checked from your Aadhaar. Make sure it is correct.
note.rythuBima.claim: Make sure your nominee's name is given at the agriculture office (AEO).
scheme.krishakBandhu.name: Krishak Bandhu (West Bengal)
scheme.krishakBandhu.benefit: Up to ₹10,000 a year from the West Bengal government, in two instalments. Less than 1 acre gets less money, at least ₹4,000.
reason.krishakBandhu.cultivates.pass: You farm, on your own land or as a sharecropper (bargadar).
reason.krishakBandhu.cultivates.fail: Krishak Bandhu is for farmers and recorded sharecroppers (bargadars).
note.krishakBandhu.death: If a farmer aged 18 to 60 dies, the family can get ₹2 lakh.
note.krishakBandhu.bargadar: Sharecroppers need their name recorded as bargadar.
doc.rorOrBargadar: Land record (RoR / patta) or bargadar certificate
scheme.uzhavar.name: Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (Tamil Nadu)
scheme.uzhavar.benefit: A membership card that gives help for farming families: money for children's education and marriage, accident and death help, and old age pension.
reason.uzhavar.landLimit.pass: Your land is within the limit (wet land up to 2.5 acres, or dry land up to 5 acres).
reason.uzhavar.landLimit.fail: This is only for small farmers: wet land up to 2.5 acres, or dry land up to 5 acres.
reason.uzhavar.wetOrDry: For wet (irrigated) land the limit is 2.5 acres; for dry land it is 5 acres. Ask the taluk office.
reason.uzhavar.age.pass: Your age is within 18 to 65 years.
reason.uzhavar.age.fail: Members must be 18 to 65 years old.
reason.uzhavar.age.unsure: Members must be 18 to 65 years old. Ask the taluk office.
reason.uzhavar.cultivates.pass: You farm the land yourself, or as a tenant.
reason.uzhavar.cultivates.fail: Farm workers can also join. Ask the taluk office.
note.uzhavar.card: Apply at the taluk (tahsildar) office for the membership card.
note.uzhavar.amounts: Ask the office for the current help amounts.
